cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: One Thing Leads to Another
cards.instruction: Use each small problem to justify solving a broader, more disruptive problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. This café chair wobbles. Let's take all the chairs apart and check their joints. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I tested them. It's only this chair, on this floorboard.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Then we'll lift the floorboards. The chairs have exposed a flooring problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: We'll close for renovations. Once the floor's up, we can move the counter and sort out the queue.
